title: Why Do We Smell Smoke?
hook: Smell is an early warning system.
narration: Smell is an early warning system.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Smell Smoke.
Smoke means fire might be near.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Your nose sends a fast message: check and get safe.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
If you smell smoke, tell a grown-up.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Smell is an early warning system.
The pictures today are a new fire world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we smell smoke.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
